lines: Possessing the entry into the greatness of own vigor-bliss: who give s
iddhi — of them, externality is form-loss.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ
